```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table">')
cat('<thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # We use htmltools to ensure the string is treated as RAW HTML
  img_url <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]), "@main/Capture.PNG")
  repo_name <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_name, "/")
  
  cat('<tr>')
  # The 'raw' HTML tags here are key
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_url, '" width="250" style="display:block;"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Demo</a> | <a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')
